name: Sleeplessness
overview: Scripture reveals that true rest and peaceful sleep come from trusting in the Lord's protection and provision, as seen in Psalms where God alone grants safety and grants sleep to His beloved. Wisdom and discretion guard the heart, enabling sweet sleep without fear, emphasizing a life rooted in godly understanding. Additionally, maintaining a forgiving heart and seeking God in prayer, as Jesus exemplified, fosters spiritual peace that supports restful sleep.
